# Draft:Maheshwari Netherlands

Maheshwari Netherlands is an Indian diaspora community organization based in the Netherlands. The organization has been covered by multiple Indian news outlets for its cultural events in the Netherlands, including a Mahesh Navami celebration in Amsterdam in June 2025 and an Annakut–Diwali gathering in November 2024.
History
Maheshwari Netherlands was established in 2024 to connect members of the Maheshwari community living in the Netherlands.
Activities
The organization conducts cultural and community gatherings for Maheshwari families living in the Netherlands.
Indian news outlets reported on a Mahesh Navami programme held in Amsterdam in June 2025, describing participation by more than 40 Maheshwari families and cultural activities during the event.
An Indian news report in November 2024 described an Annakut and Diwali gathering in Amsterdam held at Asamai Temple, with participation from more than 60 families and a community meal.
Media coverage
Maheshwari Netherlands and its community events in the Netherlands have been reported by Indian news outlets, including coverage of Mahesh Navami in June 2025 and an Annakut–Diwali gathering in November 2024.
